projectDescription: Harvest International School is a Cambridge-affiliated international school in Klang, Malaysia, offering Cambridge Primary and Secondary (IGCSE) programmes for students aged 7–17, with a focus on holistic, inquiry-based education.
keyFeatures: Cambridge International IGCSE curriculum (Primary and Secondary)
Small class sizes for personalised attention
Wide range of co-curricular clubs and activities
Licensed by the Ministry of Education Malaysia
Annual events including Sports Day and Harvest's Got Talent
Strong teacher-student relationships in a nurturing environment
International school community in Klang, Malaysia
publicApiSurface: Location: Lot 6934, Berkeley Complex, Jalan Lang, Taman Berkeley, Klang, Malaysia
Co-curricular clubs: Interact Club, St John Ambulance, Sports & Games, Editorial, Speech & Drama, Chess Club, Christian Fellowship
